from pathlib import Path
from datetime import datetime,date
from zoneinfo import ZoneInfo
import json,hashlib,csv,re
root=Path.cwd(); out=root/'reports/research/510300_treasury_soma_all_revision_prior_policy_sources_v1'
result=json.loads((out/'result.json').read_text(encoding='utf-8-sig'))
raw=json.loads((out/'同季度原表三行及前次原件交叉.json').read_text(encoding='utf-8-sig'))
saved=list(csv.DictReader((out/'五季度SOMA修订的上游信息及未知量.csv').open(encoding='utf-8-sig',newline='')))
assert len(saved)==len(raw)==len(result['fixed_cases'])==5
for c,t,r in zip(result['fixed_cases'],saved,raw):
 assert c['quarter']==t['quarter']==r['quarter']
 assert c['soma_redemption_estimate_before']==-r['prior_vector'][-1]
 assert c['soma_redemption_estimate_after']==-r['current_vector'][-1]
 assert c['soma_memo_revision_reported']==r['reported_revision_vector'][-1]==r['current_vector'][-1]-r['prior_vector'][-1]
 assert int(t['soma_memo_revision_reported'])==c['soma_memo_revision_reported']
 if c['policy_announcement_date']:
  assert (date.fromisoformat(c['current_treasury_body_date'])-date.fromisoformat(c['policy_announcement_date'])).days==c['prior_policy_calendar_days']
  assert c['soma_memo_revision_reported']-c['simple_cap_path_change_in_signed_memo']==c['reported_memo_minus_simple_path']
assert [r['prior_policy_calendar_days'] for r in result['fixed_cases']]==[89,None,89,40,5]
assert result['policy_prior_case_count']==4 and result['simple_cap_arithmetic_compatible_case_count']==3
assert all(c['full_quantity_cause_identified'] is False for c in result['fixed_cases'])
assert result['new_equity_labels']==result['new_fits']==result['new_accounts']==result['new_repository_source_code_edits']==0
assert result['account_net_sharpe']=='NOT_COMPUTED' and result['goal_achieved'] is False
parents=json.loads((out/'parent_input_hashes.json').read_text(encoding='utf-8-sig'))
for r in parents: assert hashlib.sha256((root/r['path']).read_bytes()).hexdigest()==r['sha256']
receipts=json.loads((out/'source_receipts.json').read_text(encoding='utf-8-sig'))
for r in receipts: assert hashlib.sha256((root/r['path']).read_bytes()).hexdigest()==r['sha256']
assert len(receipts)==3 and all(len(r['attempts'])==1 for r in receipts)
for name in ['config/510300_historical_cause_discovery_v1.json','config/510300_existing_data_training_mandate_v1.json']:
 cfg=json.loads((root/name).read_text(encoding='utf-8-sig'))
 assert cfg['target_net_sharpe']==1.2 and cfg['target_net_cagr']==.1 and cfg['target_max_drawdown']==.1 and cfg['goal_achieved'] is False
 assert cfg['latest_completed_study']=='reports/research/510300_treasury_soma_all_revision_prior_policy_sources_v1/result.json'
 assert cfg['next_historical_question']=='reports/research/510300_treasury_soma_all_revision_prior_policy_sources_v1/next_experiment.json'
update=json.loads((out/'长期事实更新回执.json').read_text(encoding='utf-8-sig'))
assert update['project_state_technical_section6_preserved'] and update['project_state_section12_and_after_preserved'] and update['research_decisions_section10_and_after_preserved']
checked=[]
for name in ['五季度上游政策与未知金额_来源结论.md']:
 p=out/name; text=p.read_text(encoding='utf-8-sig')
 for label,target in re.findall(r'\[([^\]]+)\]\(([^)]+)\)',text):
  if target.startswith('http'): continue
  assert (p.parent/target).exists(), '报告链接不存在：'+target
  checked.append(target)
 assert '0上限' in text and '不能伪称原文打印' in text
 assert ('原因未知' in text or '原因未定位' in text) and '完整目标未达' in text, '报告未明确保留未知原因或目标未达'
programs=[]
for p in sorted(out.glob('*执行记录.json')):
 d=json.loads(p.read_text(encoding='utf-8-sig')); code=d['executed_source']
 compile(code,str(p),'exec')
 programs.append({'path':p.relative_to(root).as_posix(),'sha256':hashlib.sha256(p.read_bytes()).hexdigest(),'complete_source_saved':True})
assert len(programs)==8
check={'study_id':result['study_id'],'verified_at':datetime.now(ZoneInfo('Asia/Shanghai')).isoformat(),'status':'PASS_SAVED_SOURCE_NUMBERS_CLOCKS_LINKS_AND_SCOPE','original_row_and_saved_csv_case_count':5,'parent_input_hashes_unchanged':len(parents),'new_source_hashes_unchanged':3,'new_source_http_attempts':3,'policy_prior_days':[89,None,89,40,5],'policy_prior_cases':4,'simple_numeric_compatibilities':3,'quantity_cause_and_consensus_not_certified':True,'report_local_link_count':len(checked),'execution_records':programs,'legacy_frozen_result_hashes_preserved':True,'full_goal_targets_unchanged':True,'other_branch_content_preserved_at_write':True,'new_equity_labels':0,'new_fits':0,'new_accounts':0,'new_repository_source_code_edits':0,'independent_financial_validation':False,'goal_achieved':False,'E15_status':'PROPOSED_NOT_REGISTERED_NOT_RUN'}
fix={'failed_attempt_record':'07_保存来源必要核对执行记录.json','failed_exit_code':1,'failed_line':44,'cause':'校验器要求报告必须含未识别，实际报告以原因未知/原因未定位明确保留同一事实；此前数值/时钟/源hash核对已通过。','repair':'只修保存检验的同义文案断言，07失败程序保留；不改源、样本、经济定义、数字或长期文档，不重跑模型。','successful_attempt_record':'08_保存来源文案断言修正执行记录.json','new_source_code_edits':0}
with (out/'保存核对实现修正回执.json').open('x',encoding='utf-8') as f: json.dump(fix,f,ensure_ascii=False,indent=2); f.write('\n')
with (out/'保存来源及长期状态必要核对.json').open('x',encoding='utf-8') as h: json.dump(check,h,ensure_ascii=False,indent=2); h.write('\n')
print('必要保存核对通过：5病例、27父hash/3新源、3实际请求；原金额/先后、报告链接与目标口径一致。')
for name in ['docs/PROJECT_STATE.md','docs/RESEARCH_DECISIONS.md']:
 lines=(root/name).read_text(encoding='utf-8-sig').splitlines()
 for i,l in enumerate(lines,1):
  if l.startswith('### 5.14') or l.startswith('### E15') or l.startswith('### R72'):
   print(name+':'+str(i)+' '+l)
